info.name: Learning
info.summary: Spaced Repetition, Story-RPG Campaigns, AI Tutor & Gamification for Nextcloud
info.description:
**Learning** turns Nextcloud into a full-featured learning platform with spaced repetition, story-driven campaigns, AI tutoring, and competitive game modes.
## Story RPG — "Abenteuer" Mode
Play through 20 real-world IT incident campaigns (SolarWinds, WannaCry, Colonial Pipeline, and more). Choose your character class, make decisions, pass skill checks, and learn through narrative. AI-powered narrator generates dynamic NPC dialog and validates freetext actions.
## Hack Through Time — "Zeitreise"
Travel through 7 epochs of hacking history — from 1960s Phone Phreaking to Quantum Dawn. Each epoch has its own CSS theme, character classes, museum facts, and campaign scenarios.
## Learning Modes
- **Smart Queue** — One-click review of all due cards, prioritized by urgency - **Leitner Spaced Repetition** — 5-box system (1d, 3d, 7d, 14d intervals) - **Training Mode** — Quick quiz sessions with immediate feedback - **Exam Mode** — Timed exams with configurable question count - **PBQ Simulations** — Performance-based questions with CLI terminals, dropdowns, network topology placement - **Trouble Spots** — Focused practice on your hardest questions - **Daily Challenge** — One question per day with bonus XP
## Competitive Modes
- **Live Duel** — 1v1 real-time quiz battles with invite system - **Sprint** — 2-5 players, fastest correct answer scores highest - **Elimination** — Last player standing, 3 lives each - **Liga** — Seasonal league with weekly rankings - **Oldschool** — Board games: Lernwuerfel (dice) and Wissensturm (tower)
## AI Features (optional, requires Gemini API key)
- **VirtuProf** — AI learning assistant with chat, RAG-powered course material answers with source citations - **AI Question Generator** — Generate questions from pasted text - **Note Generator** — AI-powered topic summaries saved to Nextcloud Files - **Ticket Triage** — AI classification of student support tickets
## Tools
- **Subnet Calculator** — IPv4 subnet calculator with binary display and VLSM planner
## Question Types
- Multiple Choice, Free Text (fuzzy matching), PBQ Simulations - CSV/JSON Import & Export, Pool Sharing, Multi-Language Translations
## Gamification
- XP & Levels, 14 Badges, Streak Multipliers, Daily Goal, Level-Up Celebration
## Course Management
- Instructor courses with pool assignment, student enrollment, leaderboard - Per-student progress tracking, at-risk warnings, role-based UX - Course material upload with RAG integration
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 29, 30, or 31 - PHP 8.1+ - PostgreSQL 13+ or MySQL 8+ - Optional: Google Gemini API key for AI features
